findings.description: Enumeration: all 112 pinned captures re-hashed (0 mismatches). EE roster (EE/faculty.html) yields 108 entries = 108 required people = expected_primary_profile_urls; every person has a single consistent title across the roster, EECS current list and EE current list. Profiles scanned in full for incoming/adjunct/courtesy/emeritus/retired/below-the-line wording.
Carmen Amo Alonso: directory "Assistant Professor"; official EECS profile announces start in 2027 -> included/regular/incoming, effective 2027 (year).
Mekhail Anwar: "Adjunct Professor" on roster, EECS current list, EE current list and profile header; undated bio "Associate Professor in Residence" does not override -> excluded/adjunct/not_in_core.

Eric Y. Ma: directory "Below The Line Assistant Professor"; official profile "Assistant Professor in Physics and by courtesy EECS". Explicit courtesy controls the category -> included/courtesy/current. Both readings are included categories; count unaffected.
Alexandra von Meier: directory and profile header "Adjunct Professor, Retired"; bio "was an Adjunct Professor" -> excluded/adjunct, current_state past (former appointment).
Qian Xu: directory "Assistant Professor"; official EECS profile announces start in 2027 -> included/regular/incoming, effective 2027 (year).

Counts: included=65 (incoming=2); breakdown excluded/adjunct/not_in_core=4; excluded/adjunct/past=1; excluded/emeritus/not_in_core=35; excluded/teaching/not_in_core=3; included/affiliate_professor/current=5; included/courtesy/current=1; included/in_residence/current=2; included/regular/current=55; included/regular/incoming=2. No unresolved records.
